comparison.objective: Connect each server's two power cords to different power strips.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated plug routing and socket insertion with cross-reaches, not fastener unlocking, fine adjustment, or witness-torque testing.
comparison.success_condition: All six plugs inserted and every server split across PDU A and B; insertion-depth tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests redundant power topology plus connector insertion rather than adjustable shock absorption.
